protocols.title: Cerluten (Brain Bioregulator) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Oral capsule convention, commonly 20 mg: 1–2 capsules daily for 10–30 days, often before meals, repeated 2–3 times/year. Proprietary animal brain/CNS extract distinct from Cortexin/Cortagen; not validated therapeutic dose.

schedule.description: Usually before a meal; repeat 2–3 courses/year.

regimen.notes: Page reports 20 mg capsules; 1–2 capsules daily for 10–30 days, repeated 2–3 times/year. Dose is capsule count; 20 mg per capsule is formulation strength, not number of capsules.
